proposal.name: 敵基地のデータを奪還せよ

legend.#: impassable wall (blocks movement and ordinary line-of-sight; proposed)
legend.u: reserved enemy respawn pad (traversable unless occupied)

board.extractionZoneOverlay: extraction cells are not drawn as distinct ASCII tokens; consume explicit array
designIntent: Direct central corridor F5 exists but F4 is occupied by a durable guard; flanking through columns C/D or H/I remains possible.
E5/G5 break some lateral movement and line-of-sight without sealing a route to the terminal.
Return zone is adjacent to ally deployment and requires the data carrier to travel back, rather than simply destroying enemies.
board.movementGeometry: Use global per-frame movement type, path and line-of-sight rules; no mission-local special exception.

turnsAndTime.timeout: after the last action of round 10, if not extracted, defeat
turnsAndTime.carrierCannotTransferCargoDirectly: candidate: transfer requires drop/recovery, direct ally-to-ally transfer not supported
turnsAndTime.tiedOutcomes: Mission win/loss simultaneous resolution uses future shared tie-break rule.

extraction.trigger: end of any allied action that leaves a living carrier on an extraction cell
extraction.guard: data.status == carried && holder.alive && holder.cell in extraction.cells

invariants: at most one data object exists
exactly one holder while carried, none otherwise
extracted is terminal and implies mission win
everDropped is monotonic and persists after repickup

victory.resolution: immediately after action and any forced damage/drop events

subobjective.name: データを一度も落とさず帰還
subobjective.onceFailed: cannot be recovered even if data is recovered again

objectives.missedPickup: No instant pick-up from reaching console; interaction consumes a unit's action.

enemySetup.skillLevel: normal attacks plus intelligent movement; no unfair handicaps

respawn.reference: reuse same enemy archetype with restored base HP/EN (no random upgrades)

schedule.spawnOrder: earliest eligible deathRound, tie by raider/guard/gunner order
schedule.occupiedOrBlockedPad: defer until earliest next start-of-round with free pad

afterSpawn.actionEligibility: normal action order in respawn round; no scripted extra turn
afterSpawn.stableUnitId: archetype id with incrementing spawn count for combat log; do not count as additional reward

enemyAI.base: reuse previously proposed M01 deterministic non-pacifist baseline, with objective awareness
priority: If an allied carrier exists, attack or intercept it, using only its publicly observable position; do not read future player choices.
Guard fights at terminal approach and can pursue nearby allies; never gains invulnerable interception ability.
Raider seeks a route between carrier and extraction; before pickup, can pursue threatening allies.
Gunner covers lanes and targets vulnerable allies, with carrier as high-priority after pickup.
If damage cannot be delivered, move toward a legal attack/interception position instead of passing intentionally.
A target that can be legally eliminated this action may be prioritized; no forced 'tutorial mercy'.
enemyAI.deterministicTieBreak: lowest target id then lexicographically ordered cell; details subject to game-core convention
enemyAI.enemyRespawnBehavior: new instance follows same AI; no forced immediate attack

routeFeasibility.routeMetric: orthogonal steps ignoring actors, only blocked cells impassable
routeFeasibility.note: Not a legal action simulation. Enemies, movement types, attack decisions and line of sight may alter actual travel.

riskControls: 10 rounds is tight enough that stopping to kill all respawning enemies may cause timeout.
Carrier death triggers real lost time because an ally must recover a dropped item, and spoils subobjective.
Enemy damage is not artificially reduced; three focused normal attacks can destroy a fragile Lv1 frame.
Enemy respawns can create new pressure but are gated at one spawn per round and at most three active enemies.
No hard victory guarantee: only player movement and risk decisions determine outcome.

openIssues: Confirm 10-round limit, three-cell enemy starting array, wall locations and extraction size.
Confirm item-interaction adjacency and whether dropped data pickup from adjacent tile is permissible.
Confirm cargo carried through special movement, ally transfer prohibition and whether enemy kills ever disable a mission instead of cycling.
Enemy respawn pad assignment, 2-round cooldown, one-per-round spawn cap and acting timing are unconfirmed proposals.
Global movement geometry and team phase ordering are not yet implemented; no full battle simulation completed.
Possible softlock if a spawn pad remains permanently occupied by player requires tested respawn defer logic.
Data dropped at an inaccessible tile due to forced movement or destruction over impassable terrain needs explicit global drop-placement fallback.
Allied total wipe, completion on same tick as wipe and timeout tie need common mission adjudication.
